$comment: This repository's own values for the task-record check in
@example/verify-standards. The package holds the grammar and the
decisions; every value below is a choice this repository makes and can
change without waiting for a package release.
recordLabels are the field labels this repository's pull requests actually
use to introduce a work-item reference, read off merged pull requests
rather than guessed. A label listed that nobody writes finds nothing; a
label omitted that people do write reports a missing record that is really
present. This is the one part of this file worth re-reading whenever the
applicableEventKinds lists the events verify-standards.yml evaluates
task-record on. pull_request_review is here because
verify-standards.yml re-runs on submitted and dismissed reviews (#1470)
and must report task-record there too, not only review-evidence.
